title: Research sprint goal: The public root is confirmed current by a tagged census, and its open conflicts are worked against it
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: 2026-10-20 planning: the census ST-zpe7qxtv waits for this story. Open questions: which hosts the census network policy blocks here (census.py check notes blocked), and what the sprint-A tool changes (judge before groups, Learn locale form, LEARN_MAP) change in the census.py run --dry-run steps and the summary's queue block; the census is run by the orchestrator from a checkout outside .claude/worktrees (census.py dispatch refuses there). 2026-10-21 findings. (1) Network: one census.fetch_once GET to each of the 269 hosts of the live sources: 0 blocked, 260 answered 200. Origin 403 (NEEDS-READING, http 403, not blocked): genai.owasp.org (8 sources), www.cisa.gov (4), wiki.alpinelinux.org (2), medium.com (1), www.npmjs.com (1). The 2026-09-25 census had the OWASP hosts blocked and 09-26 had them 200: read the summary's blocked line, not this list. Two sources with a literal space in the url fail InvalidURL: BG-kptpx5xr. (2) Tools: run --dry-run is the same 7 steps; judge runs after run and before groups, and the summary's queue block then leaves supported items out (2026-10-11 log: 19 items, 12 queued). LEARN_MAP maps 366 of 1473 live Learn rows to a docs repository (146 before), decided by git with no Learn request, but windows-itpro-docs (45) and memdocs (135) answer 404, so those 180 are asked of Learn; 758 locale-less urls go to /en-us/ directly. dispatch refuses under .claude/worktrees. (3) 116 of 206 conflict entries are open: 24 mecm/intune/sqlserver/ad/gpo, 32 agents/claude/mcp/prior-art/no topic, 41 arch/auth/privacy/security/gitlab/logs, 19 windows/entra/graph/defender: the four stories cover all. No outside facts: the questions were about this repository's census tools, this host's network and the ledger, and no fact about an outside source was learned.
